Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to watch the flowers grow in her garden. One day, she saw a lovely flower and decided to pour some water all over her garden. 

Lily's mom came outside and saw the flower grow. She told Lily that the flower was very beautiful and they had a lot. Lily was happy to hear that.
